caption: Save this for your toddler’s next breakfast 🥔🍳✨ This easy, hearty + healthy breakfast is such a hit in our house… it’s so good I end up eating it with her every time 🤍 Ingredients: • 1 potato, thinly sliced   • 2 eggs, whisked   • Chopped veggies of your choice   • Shredded cheese   Instructions: 1. Add sliced potatoes to an oiled pan on low heat   2. Cover and cook ~5 mins (until fork-tender)   3. Pour in eggs + add veggies   4. Cover and cook a few more minutes   5. Add cheese, fold in half   6. Cook a little longer until set   That’s it — simple, filling, and so delicious!
